resources.string: Retake the image under better lighting, or consult a qualified agricultural specialist.
This result is an AI screening aid, not a definitive expert diagnosis. It does not replace assessment by a qualified agricultural specialist.
This application does not provide pesticide, dosage, or treatment recommendations.

All processing happens on this device. Images never leave the phone: the application declares no internet permission, so it is structurally incapable of transmitting them. Captures and any feedback you record are stored only in this app\'s own folder.
